chapter.verse: Zing ciang hun-a ding kima-sialh kei in, tu leh tua hun kikal-a piang ding na thei kei hi.
Midangte’ hong phat loh buang, nang kiphat tawm kei in. Khualmite’ hong phat loh buang, nangma kam-in kiphat tawm kei in.
Suangtum leh sehnel gik mahmah a, ahi zongin mihaite’ pian’sak lungkhamna gikzaw lai hi.
Hehna leh sinsona siahuai a, ahi zongin hazatna siahuai zaw lai hi.
Itna i seelbawl sangin, a langtang-a taina hoihzaw hi.
I lawmte in hong liamsak khak hangin, i hoih nading hong deihsakna hi a, i galte’ hong ngawng kawina in, hong lehbawlna ahi hi.
A gilvah mipa in khuaizu nangawn duh nawn lo a, a gilkial mipa in a kha an nangawn lim sa hi.
Inn panin gamlapi-ah a zinkhia mipa in, a bu panin a leengkhia vasa tawh kibang hi.
Sathau namtui leh paknamtui in lungnuam sak a, lawmte’ limbawlna in tha hatsak hi.
Na lawmte daang koih kei in la, na pa’ lawmte dong nangawn lawm bawl in. Na lungkham ciangin na sanggampa va ko kei in, a gamla-a om i sanggampa sangin, i nai-a om i vengpa kimang zaw hi.
Ka ta aw, pil in, tua hi leh ka lungdam ding a, kei hong mawhsak nuamte in bangmah hong cih thei lo ding hi.
Mipilte in a lauhuai thu mu thei-in pelh uh a, mi mawkmawkte in phu suakin thuak uh hi.
Mi khat in gamdang mi khat’ leiba lohsak dingin kam a hai ciam leh, a ciam bangin a neihsa kilaksak takpi ding hi.
Mi khat in a kituak lopi-in midang khat limbawl lua liang leh, amah in a sia lam-in na ngaihsun zaw hi.
Phun bekbek a thei zi in, theu hun mel a nei lo guah ciin tawh kibang hi.
Tua bang numei kikho thei lo a, a kikham thei lo huihnung, leh i khut-a sathau tawi nop tawh kibang hi.
Sik in sik mah hiamsak thei a, mi in midang pilsak thei hi.
Theikung a cingpa in a gah ne a, a topa a kempa in pahtakna ngah hi.
Tui sung en leeng eima maitang i muh bangin, i lungsim en leeng eima pian’zia kilang hi.
Mihingte’ lungsim in mi site’ gam tawh kibang a, tamlua cih hun nei thei lo hi.
Ngun leh khamte, meikhuk-ah kize-et a, mihing ahih leh phatna tawh kize-et hi.
Mihai khat a sih dek dongin na satsat hangin, a hai ngei mah-in hai veve lai ding hi.
Na tuuhonte hoih takin thei in la, na bawnghonte hoih takin kem in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh neihsa kip tawngtung lo a, hauhna pen, a khang khangin kizom suak lo hi.
Lopate ki-at mang khin a, ahi zongin a no hong sel kik hi; mualtung a, po lopa hing khempeuh ki-atin inn-ah kipua a,
tuute in na puan ding hong guan a, na keeltal mante in lo cing khat man tawh kikim hi.
Na keelnawite ahih leh, na innkuan an nek ding, leh na nasem numeite nuntak nadingin kicing ding hi.
